'''Chem''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was in his youth during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a conflict spurred by the invasion of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. His [[Chem's mother|mother]] was a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] who collected pristine [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. On his fourteenth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]], Chem left home to join [[Kyp's Dozen]], an elite starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] headed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]]. He stole his mother's most prized possession, a prototype of the [[T-65XJ X-wing starfighter]], to fulfill his goal. Locating Kyp's Dozen, Chem spent several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the squadron around before being accepted into the unit. He fought during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fall]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the engagement when his fighter was hit by enemy [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] fire.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Keep focused, Five. I'd hate to see you get a scratch on that showpiece of yours.''"<br />"''So would I, sir. Under those circumstances, I'd rather face the warmaster himself than the ship's rightful owner.|Kyp Durron and Chem|<ref name="Dark Journey" />}}
Born prior to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="age" /> Chem was the son of a wealthy [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]], a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who was a collector of pristine-condition, never-flown [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. On Chem's fourteenth birthday, he stole his [[Chem's mother|mother's]] most prized possession&mdash;an early prototype model [[T-65XJ X-wing starfighter]]&mdash;from the warehouse she kept her collection in. He set out to find [[Kyp's Dozen]], a starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

After tracking them down, Chem did not ask for admission into the squadron. Instead, he followed the unit around from mission to mission as they fought in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict fought between the allied governments of the galaxy and the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders. Eventually, after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Master Durron accepted him into the squadron after the loss and replacement of countless [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], giving him the position of [[Dozen Five]]. Chem soon used his inheritance to purchase new XJ X-wing starfighters, fuel, and ordnance for the Dozen, as well as destroying seven [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

[[File:Jedi_Master_Kyp_Durron.jpg|thumb|right|Kyp Durron, Chem's commanding officer]]
In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|assaulted]] the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> The battle lasted for several [[Standard day/Legends|days]], and toward the end of the engagement, the Dozen were assigned to provide escort cover for a small [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fleet that was escaping from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The main [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the fleet was carrying the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Danni Quee]] and her invention that could jam the Yuuzhan Vong's [[yammosk]] war coordinators&mdash;telepathic organisms that acted as command and control systems for the Yuuzhan Vong's ships and fighters, allowing them to operate in near-perfect unison.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

As the Dozen dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Chem was distracted by the sight of Coruscant's lights going out. The [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]&mdash;noted for being a world that never truly slept&mdash;was gradually losing power as the Yuuzhan Vong invasion took hold. Master Durron, in a conversation with the youth on a private channel, told him that it was their job to hold back the night. Reassured, Chem followed Durron into battle against enemy coralskippers. However, he kept his ship behind the Jedi Master's, instead of breaking into the four-ship formations that Durron had ordered. As Durron engaged the enemy, he used his [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] to perform a vertical rise to avoid incoming fire, which subsequently impacted Chem's fighter. The [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] bursts destroyed Chem's fighter, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. Durron felt a sense of guilt and grief over the young man's death, and sensed through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] Chem's own fear and disbelief as he died.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Personality and traits==
A young man, Chem's voice had yet to reach a baritone level by the time of his death. He was a competent pilot, able to hold his own with the other pilots of the Dozen, and proved his combat skills by destroying seven enemy craft during his tenure with the unit. Although he presented a laid-back attitude, and was able to banter with the older and more experienced members of the squadron, he was easily unnerved. The sight of Coruscant experiencing its first true night in millennia was enough to distract the youth during the Yuuzhan Vong's invasion of the world.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

A determined individual, Chem followed his own ideals, which led him to absconding from home with one of his mother's prized possessions. He did not look forward to seeing her again, worried about what she would do to him over the stolen ship. His dogged determination eventually earned him a spot in the Dozen. A generous young man, he thought nothing of using his family wealth to buy the squadron needed supplies.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chem's only appearance was in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]'' by [[Elaine Cunningham]]. Published in [[2002]], it was part of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series.<ref name="Dark Journey" />
